messages.subject: inla.surv with truncation
parts:
I am trying to use the semi-parametric baseline hazard model with truncated data. My data are (time,event,truncation) so inla.surv.1 is called in inla() when family="coxph".  

inla.surv.1() has something like:

ss=list(time=surv.time. lower=surv.lower,upper=surv.upper,event=event,truncation=truncation)  ### This is what I need
class(ss)="inla.surv"  ### removes all the elements of the ss list except surv.time
return(ss)

How can I use "truncation"?

Thanks
~Julia

messages.author: 44061f4bfa545163
messages.subject: Re: inla.surv with truncation
parts: I see. I need to add a vector called time2 and convert my data to (time,event,time2,truncation). That solves the problem.
